summary: Archive transitions and review decisions are administrator-only. Strict request validators protect identity, schema, timestamps and immutable fields. Approval checks archived customer state with getAfter; request and customer are updated atomically by the application. Physical deletion remains denied. Test results are recorded separately; this review is not a formal security certification.

findings.issue: A malicious active staff account can submit duplicate bounded archive request documents via direct API calls; normal UI suppresses own pending duplicates.
findings.recommendation: Add rate-limited server submission or a transactional pending-request uniqueness index if request spam becomes a concern.
